findings: Follow-up caller tracing corrects the checkpoint2 gap note: DeepSeek >=400 is buffered in local_rewrite_search_fallback before response dispatch. Non-2xx SSE is not uniformly streamed by the pinned reference.
Statuses below 400 reach Live(response); only 2xx Responses invoke chat-compatible translation. A 3xx SSE response reaches raw passthrough with no derived quota projection.

The pinned streamed response dispatcher filters HeaderValue::to_str failures before forwarding text headers. Modex now drops non-ASCII values on passthrough streams while retaining valid ASCII/HTAB and Connection-nominated header filtering.
A shared native passthrough response function now serves Chat Completions and early Responses status paths, preserving buffered >=400 behavior and 204/304 body suppression.

Synthetic 307 prefix comparison through the real Super CLI matches the checksum-pinned release: receive 64 KiB before EOF with a 1-second client read timeout and a 3-second held-open upstream. Exactly one upstream POST; malformed non-ASCII stream header omitted by both.
Native tests cover 302/307/308 on both routes, successful Chat SSE, early chunk delivery, downstream RST cleanup, no POST replay and truncation after the retained 4 MiB unknown-length redirect cap.

Pinned core_constants.rs also sets the buffered error response cap to 4 MiB; that existing Modex cap is retained. Redirect streaming retains an extra 4 MiB guard not established as reference-equivalent.
